purpose: Diagnose layerwise and temporal activation/gradient dynamics in selected v3 winner, boundary and counterexample cells. This is not a new primary efficacy test.
pairing: Same task, depth, seed, initialization and train/test sampling stream across activations.
decision_boundary: Descriptive diagnostic study only. No parameter search; no post-hoc efficacy gate.
exclusions: No changes to PreCap-v9, architecture, optimizer, task definitions, checkpoint schedule or seed set after launch.
